_comment: Gudauri corrections. (1) 'Frini' blue piste reversal: the top/north endpoint n6225190102 (42.5111, 44.4929), which is really the ~2951 m summit hub next to sn6211635548 (13 m away, correctly 2951 m) and where the Frini run's own polyline peaks at 2951 m, was DEM-sampled at 2698 m. That false low made the 2.4 km Frini piste orient south->north (uphill) and pushed the short Kobi top link n6225190102->sn6211635548 uphill too. It slipped past the global pothole repair because n6225190102 is a piste_endpoint whose only piste-way neighbour is the low sn6211635547 (the n6225190102->sn6211635548 Kobi link is an inferred 8 m connector), so it read as a genuine run end. Set n6225190102 to 2951 m so Frini descends north->south and Kobi's top stays level. (2) DEM cross-check (`npm run check:elevation`) + map verification: the n1815101343->n1708888875 arrows ran uphill. n1708888875 is really ~2840 m and n1815101343 ~2826 m, so that link descends n1708888875->n1815101343. n1815101343 is the shared bottom of the n13564024959 and n1708888875 runs and sits only ~42 m from the 2813 m lift-station cluster (n11464490749/sn1708888489/n11711980247/n1708888489), but OSM has no way joining them, so correcting the elevations left n1815101343 with no exit. Add the missing short ski-out n1815101343->n11464490749 (~13 m drop over ~42 m) that the old, too-high n1815101343 elevation had been masking.
